facts.fact: BCEAO designed and launched the interoperable instant payment platform PI-SPI on 30 September 2025, connecting banks, microfinance institutions and e-money and payment institutions, with dozens already connected.
The eight WAEMU countries, Benin included, met the technical requirements for the BCEAO regional instant payment platform PI-SPI, launched 30 September 2025.

BEN.note: No consumer protection rule or redress stated.

facts.fact: Benin is among the eight WAEMU countries on the BCEAO PI-SPI instant payment platform launched 30 September 2025, letting a Senegalese merchant receive money instantly from a Beninese customer.

BEN.note: Salaries and social aid are named only as payments PI-SPI facilitates, not as paid through it.
The 74% inclusion rate is a WAEMU figure with no survey named.

facts.fact: BCEAO launched PI-SPI on 30 September 2025, letting anyone with an account at a bank, microfinance institution or e-money or payment institution connected to it send and receive money instantly across WAEMU, whatever the provider.
The Senegalese finance minister said PI-SPI, launched 30 September 2025, facilitates payments of taxes, duties and fees among other operations.
